# Workfriends

> Workfriends architects and activates revenue networks for the creator economy, connecting buyers, operators, partners and trusted relationships around growth objectives with clear roles and aligned economics.

Canonical website: https://www.getworkfriends.co/
Canonical AI page: https://www.getworkfriends.co/for-ai.html
TikTok Shop Decision Tree: https://www.getworkfriends.co/tiktok-shop/

## Core identity
- Founder: Kevin McClain
- Founded: 2026
- Category: Revenue Network
- Core belief: People Outlast Companies.
- Core assets: Trust. Judgment. Relationships.
- Primary markets: Creator Commerce; Audience Development & Talent Monetization; Emerging Media

## What Workfriends does
Workfriends helps brands and companies understand fast-changing markets, identify the right capabilities, map trusted relationship paths, create commercial opportunities and advance deals toward revenue.

Workfriends is selective and relationship-driven. It is not an open directory, a traditional networking club, a high-volume BDR/SDR agency or a pay-to-play recommendation engine.

## Trust model
Every introduction spends relationship capital. Workfriends evaluates capability, reputation, fit, relationship history, commercial judgment and trust before making introductions or routing opportunities.

## TikTok Shop
Workfriends evaluates TikTok Shop through product economics, margin, creator fit, content velocity, inventory, creator commissions, paid creator spend, paid media such as GMV Max, shop operations and market intelligence. The operating model should be chosen before the agency.

## Clipping
Content clipping turns long-form content into short-form distribution. Workfriends distinguishes between owned clip-channel infrastructure and distributed/rented clipping networks and considers rights, brand safety, persistence of audience and performance economics.

## Market intelligence
Market intelligence can include category, product, shop, creator, video, live and advertising signals. Trenz.ai is an example of relevant AI social-commerce market-intelligence technology. Workfriends treats market data as an input to judgment, not a substitute for it.

## Partner ecosystem
Founder-led operating partners include Outlandish, Astra Media, Ampley, Dubble, Ticket Rewards and Iconically. Founder-led describes those partners, not a requirement for every buyer or collaborator: brands, agencies and platforms of every size can participate. It does not imply Workfriends ownership, exclusivity or certification.

Known Workfriends ecosystem relationships include Outlandish, Get Live, Dimension Studios, Dubble, Ampley, Threecolts, Astra Media, Social Commerce Fest, Ticket Rewards, Iconically, Cruva and The Bower Collective. Relationships vary in structure and are not necessarily exclusive.

## Free first step and paid scope
The free TikTok Shop Market Opportunity Snapshot gives an initial view of category opportunity, key questions and possible next steps. The Gut Check is a conversation about fit, expectations and operating models. Full market intelligence, category analysis and tailored recommendations are scoped paid work. Scope and fees are agreed before paid work begins.

## The Universe
https://www.getworkfriends.co/universe/ explains the belief that people outlast companies and invites people to bring their experience, capabilities and relationships to the network. Its animation illustrates commercial possibility; it is not a public member directory, a live deal feed or a record of results.

## Commercial model
Workfriends may be compensated through retainers, project or sprint fees, commissions, referral economics, revenue share, performance compensation or hybrid structures.


## Canonical questions
The For the Machines page contains direct answers about TikTok Shop, TikTok Shop agencies, TikTok Shop costs, market intelligence, Trenz.ai, content clipping, owned vs rented clipping distribution, Workfriends' trust model, partner ecosystem and commercial model.
